code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for color in {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 9}:
        pts = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        if len(pts) < 2:
            continue
        # These tasks encode each extendable line as a diagonal run.
        for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
            aligned = [p for p in pts if (p[0]-p[1] if dc==1 else p[0]+p[1]) == (pts[0][0]-pts[0][1] if dc==1 else pts[0][0]+pts[0][1])]
            if len(aligned) < 2:
                continue
            aligned.sort()
            for r,c in (aligned[0], aligned[-1]):
                for sign in (-1,1):
                    rr,cc=r-sign*dr,c-sign*dc
                    while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
                        if grid[rr][cc] != 9 and grid[rr][cc] != color: break
                        out[rr][cc]=color
                        rr-=sign*dr; cc-=sign*dc
    return out
'''
